neighbours.label: ' in' that introduces a spatial configuration after a verb of arranging or spreading (arranged in a circle, spread out in a crescent); 'in' after other verbs stays quiet
fire: The chairs were arranged in a circle around the fire.
The riders fanned out in a long line across the plain.
Leaves are arranged in whorls of three along the stem.
The seats are laid out in rows facing the stage.
The troops spread out in a wide arc behind the hill.
The files are organized in a tree of folders.
Petals are arranged in two overlapping layers.
The stalls were set up in a horseshoe around the square.
quiet: The chairs were bought in a sale at the shop.
The riders grew up in a small town on the plain.
Leaves are eaten in spring by the insects on the stem.
The seats are sold in advance at the box office.
The troops slept in a wide barn behind the hill.
The files are stored in the cloud on a server.
Petals are collected in two large baskets.
The stalls were closed in winter because of the snow.

notes: Card: ' in' x22 after planted, spread out, arranged, scattered; ' into' x3. The - pole's logit effect relates to ' arrangement', ' distribution', ' layout'. Probe: spread out in a crescent 0.81, arranged in a nonlinear order 0.76, arranged in panicles 0.59; planted in front 0.20, scattered in the field 0.15, planted in groups 0.09; lived in, arrived in, interested in at most 0.02.
